mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.2% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate at or above 9.0% signals a weak labor market and economic stagnation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE >= 9.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (>=9.0%) and retail sales are robust (>380,000 million), it indicates a recovery phase with improving consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE>=9.0 AND RSAFS>380000, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500 thousand units signal a contracting housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 500, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) over a 60-day horizon signals sustained economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery (UNRATE>8.0% and falling), retail sales above 385,000 million indicate strong consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS>385000 in post-recession recovery, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary easing, which rapidly boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
